text:
ana: Heads-up — planning a staged canary for infer-frontend -> redwood-3-quant tomorrow 10:00 PDT. Goal: validate latency/cost after quant. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% across cohorts. @kevin you good to deploy?
kevin: I can take deploy ownership. will be on call 09:30–11:30 PDT.
nana (typo) — meant ana: @maria will you own smoke and quick evals?
maria: Yup, I'll run smoke checklist and a small eval set. I’ll post results in this thread. smoke owner checklist: health endpoint, 5 sample prompts, p95 latency check, error-rate check, model-output QA on 3 prompts.
kevin: roll plan: deploy canary replica set with header-based weight. ramps: 1% (10 min), 5% (15 min), 25% (20 min), then wait 30 min before 100%. rollback window after each step: 10 min.
dave: Which cohorts are we hitting for the percents? region split or random buckets?
nana (ana corrected): cohorts: 1% = internal traffic + small geo slice (US-west), 5% = US-west + US-east subset, 25% = add EU core, 100% = global. APAC will be in separate follow-up since we want metric stability.
sre-bot: Auto-checklist attached — will create a rollout incident thread if any metric crosses thresholds: p95 latency > 200ms OR error_rate > 0.5% OR drop in tokens/sec > 15% :warning:
releases-oncall: Scheduled on calendar for 2026-04-21 10:00 PDT, added notify @releases-oncall and @eng-oncall channels.
maria: smoke run commands I'll use:
```
curl -H 'X-Canary-Cohort: canary-1' https://infer.redwood/api/v1/health
# sample generation
curl -X POST https://infer.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello world"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Canary-Cohort: canary-1'
```
kevin: rollback command (fast): `kubectl rollout undo deployment/infer-frontend -n prod` — tested in staging. Also keep previous model pinned: `infra model pin --service infer-frontend --model redwood-3-vprev`
maria: I'll paste smoke results here. quick guardrails I’ll check: p95 latency <200ms, 5xx <0.5%, qualitative output ok for 10 eval prompts. If anything fails I call rollback immediately. :thumbsup:
dave: Are Envoy header rules already in place for X-Canary-Cohort? I don't want to add traffic rules mid-rollout.
nana (ana corrected): Yes, envoy route for X-Canary-Cohort exists and will be used. config: route match on header, weight applied in routing table. ops doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-routing (internal doc).
kevin: I'll start deploy at 10:00, announce each ramp at +10/+25/+55 mins. tagging artifacts: build 2026.04.20-rc9.
sre-bot: I'll watch dashboards: infra/infer-frontend/p95, infra/infer-frontend/5xx, infra/model-quality/score-drift. alert if any threshold breaches.
maria: prepping eval set now, will post a short table after 1% ramp. everyone please avoid unrelated config pushes in prod during the window.
kevin: thanks — ping here if you need me to pause at any step.
nana (ana corrected): Thanks team. if no objections I'll send the official deploy notice at 09:45 PDT with final runbook and the above owners. :rocket:
